mentions.name: Spicy Chess
mentions.description: A chess game with a boxing twist: players can smack their opponent to drain a health bar, and fully draining the opponent's health lets them steal their turn.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://spicychess.com: Chess, meet boxing! Imagine playing chess BUT you can also smack your opponent. Now, if you smack em enough times to drain their health completely(yes, you have a health bar), you can steal their turn.
